headline: Portfolio Outperformance vs. SPY YTD
summary: As of July 2, 2026, the portfolio set is outperforming the SPY benchmark with an average return of 15.34% compared to SPY's 9.91%. This results in an average alpha of 5.43%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but are also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has delivered an impressive return of 44.81%, contributing significantly to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Google 100', has returned 6.96%, which is still above the benchmark but highlights the variability within the portfolio set. Such outperformance can be a useful signal during times of market uncertainty, showcasing resilience against broader market trends. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
